title: DEMO: Colorado AG opens rulemaking on AI Act implementation guidance
excerpt: Demonstration item. The Colorado Attorney General's office announced a rulemaking process for implementation guidance ahead of the Colorado AI Act's effective date, covering documentation duties for developers and impact-assessment expectations for deployers.

title: DEMO: NIST AI RMF companion guidance draft opens for public comment
excerpt: Demonstration item. NIST released a draft companion resource for the AI Risk Management Framework addressing agentic AI risk profiles, opening a 60-day public comment period.

title: DEMO: OWASP Agentic AI Security guidance adds tool-abuse mitigations
excerpt: Demonstration item. The OWASP GenAI Security Project published an update to its agentic AI threat guidance with new mitigations for tool abuse, memory poisoning, and multi-agent trust boundaries.

title: DEMO: EU AI Office issues first GPAI compliance requests
excerpt: Demonstration item. The European AI Office issued its first formal information requests to general-purpose AI model providers under the EU AI Act's GPAI obligations.

title: DEMO: Research: indirect prompt injection succeeds against production agent frameworks
excerpt: Demonstration item. Security researchers demonstrated indirect prompt injection attacks achieving tool invocation in several widely used agent frameworks, recommending strict output-tool separation.

title: DEMO: ISO/IEC 42001 certifications double year-over-year
excerpt: Demonstration item. Accreditation bodies report rapid growth in ISO/IEC 42001 AI management system certifications, with financial services and healthcare leading adoption.

title: DEMO: UK opens consultation on frontier AI reporting requirements
excerpt: Demonstration item. The UK government opened a consultation on mandatory reporting requirements for frontier AI developers, signalling movement from voluntary commitments.

title: DEMO: Financial regulators warn of AI voice-cloning fraud wave
excerpt: Demonstration item. Multiple financial regulators issued coordinated warnings about AI voice-cloning fraud targeting payment authorization workflows.

title: DEMO: Singapore IMDA releases GenAI evaluation toolkit update
excerpt: Demonstration item. IMDA and the AI Verify Foundation released an updated evaluation toolkit aligned with the Model AI Governance Framework for Generative AI.

title: DEMO: IAPP webinar: operationalizing AI governance under state laws
excerpt: Demonstration item. Upcoming webinar covering compliance operations for the Colorado AI Act, Texas TRAIGA, and Illinois HB 3773. Registration open.

title: DEMO: AI governance certification adds agentic AI module
excerpt: Demonstration item. A major AI governance professional certification announced new curriculum modules on agentic AI oversight and incident response.

title: DEMO: Stanford AI Index reports surge in state-level AI legislation
excerpt: Demonstration item. The latest AI Index tracks a significant year-over-year increase in enacted state AI legislation and global regulatory activity.

title: DEMO: MITRE ATLAS adds techniques for RAG poisoning and model extraction
excerpt: Demonstration item. MITRE ATLAS published new adversary techniques covering retrieval-augmented generation poisoning and black-box model extraction observed in the wild.

title: DEMO: Hospital reports diagnostic AI misclassification affecting triage
excerpt: Demonstration item. A hospital system disclosed that a diagnostic support model misclassified cases over a two-week window, triggering internal review and regulator notification.

title: DEMO: G7 updates international code of conduct for advanced AI
excerpt: Demonstration item. G7 members endorsed an updated code of conduct for organizations developing advanced AI systems, adding incident-reporting expectations.
